units.title: 1.0 Cloud Architecture
units.summary: The planning layer of the cloud: turning business and technical requirements into a design. Service models (IaaS/PaaS/SaaS), deployment models (public/private/hybrid/community/multicloud), the shared responsibility model, cloud-native patterns (containers, microservices, serverless), then capacity planning, scaling, and how to integrate and migrate workloads into the cloud.

lessons.title: Cloud Service Models, Deployment Models & Requirements

units.title: 2.0 Deployment
units.summary: Standing up the resources a design calls for. Provisioning models and templates; deploying compute (instances, containers, serverless) with the right sizing; deploying storage (block, file, object) with tiers, RAID and protection; and building the virtual network — subnets, routing, load balancers, DNS and connectivity.

units.title: 3.0 Operations
units.summary: Keeping a running cloud healthy and affordable. Monitoring, logging and observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting); lifecycle maintenance, patching and automated upkeep; backup and disaster recovery built around RTO and RPO; and cost optimization and right-sizing — the discipline known as FinOps.

units.title: 4.0 Security
units.summary: Securing cloud workloads across the shared responsibility line. Identity and access management (authentication, authorization, MFA, RBAC, least privilege, federation); data security (encryption at rest and in transit, key management, classification); network security (segmentation, security groups, zero trust); and compliance, posture management and hardening.

units.title: 5.0 DevOps Fundamentals
units.summary: The automation culture that CV0-004 added as its own domain. CI/CD pipelines that build, test and release software, and the containers and orchestration they deploy; then infrastructure as code (declarative templates like Terraform), configuration management (Ansible), and the scripting, APIs and webhooks that glue a cloud platform together.

lessons.title: Infrastructure as Code, Configuration Management & Automation

units.title: 6.0 Troubleshooting
units.summary: Diagnosing problems methodically. The structured CompTIA troubleshooting methodology; the deployment and automation failures that break a release; connectivity problems across the virtual network (DNS, routing, security groups, VPN); and performance and capacity issues once a workload is live.
